source: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) RadLab Dosimetry
location: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) - International Space Station
comparisonNote: The ISS orbits inside Earth's protective geomagnetic shield (magnetosphere), absorbing roughly 0.3-0.5 mGy/day. On the lunar surface with no atmosphere or global magnetic field, unshielded galactic cosmic ray and solar proton risk is substantially higher (~1.0 to >100 mGy/day during storms).
